subject: Re: Orrery rollout - two blockers before we sign
body:
Scott,

Two blockers before we can sign, and both are small:

1. SSO group mapping has to survive a group rename on our side. Today a rename orphans the on-call assignment and we lose the rotation.
2. We need the on-call schedule as a CSV export for our compliance reviewer. A read-only API endpoint would work too.

Legal is holding on my answer, so a yes/no on both by Thursday is enough - I do not need a ship date, just whether they are possible.

Thanks,
Renata Okafor
Director of Platform Engineering, Northlake Fintech
_demo_note: The one real customer ask in the 30 unread. Deadline is Thursday; the answer is a yes/no, not a ship date.
